project_info.theme: AQUA football-season sale in stadium scene

main_subject.detail: A large stadium poster with AQUA branding and top-right badge 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG'. The headline reads 'HOA NHIP BONG DA SALE SAP GIA'. In the center is a huge TV screen showing cartoon children playing soccer, with a giant wet soccer ball in the foreground. An AQUA washing machine stands on the left side of the field and a refrigerator stands on the right. Bottom CTA says 'MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE'.
main_subject.style: Family-friendly sports-event appliance poster with bright cinematic stadium scene and playful animated TV content
